items.title: Password reset token exposed in URL logs and browser history
Personal data exposed to unauthorised users
Stolen reset token grants immediate authenticated session
Active sessions not terminated when password is reset
Password reset tokens intercepted via unencrypted email
Different responses reveal which email addresses have accounts
Predictable or short reset tokens can be brute forced
